rows.text: returns without work when bit 7 of byte `+0x3F3` of `rcx` is set; otherwise ORs 4 into that byte and tail-jumps at `002A2650` + 0x3C with the 0x60-byte entry at sign-extended index `edx` of the array at qword `rcx+0x3F8`, then `r8`, `r9d` and the fifth (stack) argument shifted down one register each
